ai_summary: Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL) has received a significant upgrade in its long-term credit ratings from ICRA Limited, with most bank facilities and non-convertible debentures moving from "ICRA AA-; Stable" to "ICRA AA; Stable." This positive revision signals improved creditworthiness, likely leading to better borrowing terms and enhanced investor confidence for the company. Concurrently, all short-term ratings were reaffirmed at "ICRA A1+," indicating stability in its short-term financial outlook.
